scripts.validate: vp run lint:fix && vp run typecheck && vp run build
scripts.validate:ci: vp run lint && vp run typecheck && vp run build && vp run generate:check
scripts.generate: SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo test --features full,memory-backend -p yauth --test generate_client -- generate_openapi_spec --exact --nocapture --include-ignored && vp exec orval
scripts.generate:check: SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo test --features full,memory-backend -p yauth --test generate_client -- check_openapi_spec_up_to_date --exact --nocapture && vp exec orval && git diff --exit-code packages/client/src/generated.ts packages/client/src/generated.msw.ts
